mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a robust economy, which in turn drives up demand for goods and services, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an extremely accommodative monetary policy, which boosts equity markets and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, combined with a strong increase in payroll employment, indicates a tight labor market, which drives up wages and leads to higher production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low unemployment and strong payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production, combined with a decrease in housing starts, indicates a shift in the economy from consumption to production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production and weak housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales indicates a robust consumer sector, which drives up demand for goods and services, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when retail sales are strong (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate, combined with a decrease in the consumer price index, indicates a deflationary environment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low inflation and accommodative monetary policy (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate, combined with a weak increase in payroll employment, indicates a slack labor market, which leads to lower production costs and results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high unemployment and weak payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in industrial production, combined with a strong decrease in housing starts, indicates a shift in the economy from production to consumption, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of weak industrial production and strong housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).
